references.guide: Copy is composed top-down. The promise (Director advantage.proposition.promise) is the one message every page serves. Pillars are the two to four reasons to believe it, each backed by the proof cell. Passages carry pillars; patterns carry single messages; strings carry labels. A page narrative orders passages as promise, pillars, proof, objection, action. A lower layer never introduces a claim the layer above does not support.

levels.rule: One promise per page; it appears in the hero and the closing call to action in different words.
Two to four pillars; each names a benefit and how it works.
Every number and superlative cites the Director proof cell or a lexicon claim record.
One primary action per page; the secondary action is a smaller step toward the same goal.
